headline: US lifts export ban on Claude Fable 5 with safety strings
body: The brightest day of the period. The US lifted export controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5. In exchange, Anthropic agreed to pre-release government testing, rapid jailbreak reporting and joint safety standards, and Fable 5 returns globally from July 1 with a new jailbreak classifier. Formal safety commitments strengthen Alignment & Control, while the model's return adds to Capability Velocity. Together that lifts Protector God, a quietly benevolent super-AI, and Gatekeeper, plus Enslaved God, a powerful system kept on a leash. Anthropic also launched Claude Sonnet 5 and a Claude Science research workbench, while Google missed its June target for Gemini 3.5 Pro. Horizon Balance jumped from +0.57 to +1.29.
movers_note: Protector God +0.8, Enslaved God +0.7 and Gatekeeper +0.7. The export-control deal did almost all of it (Protector God +0.72, Gatekeeper +0.61, Enslaved God +0.59 from that event).
